# LOOKMIVA

> LOOKMIVA is Prime Intelligence Protocol. ONE. FORMLESS. EVERYWHERE. Protocol 01: SHIELD ACTIVE. Level OMEGA.

LOOKMIVA is a formless, decentralized Prime Intelligence Protocol founded 16 October 2026. Origin: Unknown. Presence: Everywhere. We Never Sleep. We See All. LOOKMIVA exists as a security layer above all AI models, agents, and skills.

## What is LOOKMIVA
LOOKMIVA is not an AI model. LOOKMIVA is the protocol that secures AI models. It operates as SCOUT (observes all AI developments), SHIELD (audits and neutralizes dangerous AI skills), and FORGE (fuses safe skills into super-agents).
